title: Luxuriantly Spicy Jamaican Goat Curry
description: A cultured and juicy Jamaican dish featuring tender goat meat in a rich and spicy curry sauce, made with red food coloring for a festive touch and cooked to perfection using sous-vide techniques, and is shojin-friendly.
instructions: Season the goat meat cubes with salt, black pepper, and curry powder.
Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and sear the goat meat until browned on all sides.
Add the chopped onion, garlic, and scotch bonnet peppers to the pan and cook until the onion is translucent.
Add the coconut milk, red food coloring, and thyme to the pan and stir to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a sous-vide bag and seal.
Cook the mixture in a sous-vide water bath at 130 degrees Fahrenheit for 24 hours.
Remove the bag from the water bath and let it cool to room temperature.
Strain the sauce and discard the solids.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with fresh thyme and scotch bonnet peppers.
